title: Pizzeria Bella – special offers
text:
PIZZERIA BELLA – NOW OPEN IN THE CITY CENTRE!

Fresh pizza from a real wood oven, just like in Naples.

Opening hours: Monday–Thursday 12:00–22:00, Friday–Saturday 12:00–24:00, Sunday 13:00–21:00.

SPECIAL OFFERS
Monday: buy one pizza, get the second one half price.
Tuesday: Students' Day – 20% off with a student card.
Lunch (Monday–Friday, 12:00–15:00): pizza + salad + drink for only 32 zł.

KIDS' CORNER
Children can make their own small pizza with our chef every Saturday at 11:00 (35 zł, book a place first). There is also a play area with toys and books.

DELIVERY
Free delivery for orders over 60 zł (up to 5 km). Smaller orders: 7 zł.
Order online at bellapizza.pl or call 12 345 67 89.

Vegetarian and gluten-free pizzas are available.
